target_audience: Thai car enthusiasts interested in obscure foreign automotive history

act_structure.description: Permanent ForeignCarsTH story spine. Every episode's producer_outline.json beats each carry an act (1-4); acts are fixed and appear in order, beats within an act are flexible. Narrate as one continuous story -- never speak act/beat labels aloud.

acts.name: The weird car
acts.question: What is this weird car?
acts.purpose: Establish why this subject deserves a video: the car and its most immediately strange feature(s), raising the question the rest of the episode answers. Do not dump history or fully explain the strangeness here.

acts.name: How it happened
acts.question: How did it come to exist?
acts.purpose: The conditions that created the project: company situation, market conditions, predecessor, the people involved, the original problem or opportunity, intended customer.

acts.name: Why it was so weird
acts.question: Why did it end up like this?
acts.purpose: The main body. For each important unusual choice: WHAT they did, WHY they did it, WHAT consequence it created. Never degrade into a specification list -- the question is why reasonable people chose to build it this way.

acts.name: What happened
acts.question: What happened to it?
acts.purpose: Pay off the story: launch, price, sales, reception, production volume, cancellation/successor, survival/rarity, modern reputation. End on a meaningful consequence or reflection, not a repeated claim that the car was weird.
